item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 09/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be replaced by a southerly airstream gradually. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will improve over the region today. It will be hot during the day in the next couple of days. The anticyclone aloft is expected to cover the northern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week, and bring hot weather to the coast of southern China persistently.

Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first. Becoming south to southeast force 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Visibility relatively low in some areas at first. Hot with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 23 - 29 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
